basic_details.job_title: UOR Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Research Associate, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Community and Applied Science (earlier known as Home Science), University of Rajasthan, Jaipur, needs two Research Associates at Rs. 47000/- + HRA and two Project Assistants at Rs. 25000/- for RUSA 2.0 Project XI, "Sustainable strategies for improving the Nutritional and Health status of Vulnerable groups in Tonk District". The appointment is temporary and runs till 31 March 2027. Research Associates need a Ph.D. in Foods & Human Nutrition (submitted or awarded), and Project Assistants need an M.Sc in Foods & Human Nutrition / Human Development & Family & Development Communic

how_to_apply: Applications are made on paper. The application form is printed with the notice under the University of Rajasthan letterhead, headed "Name of the Post for which apply under RUSA 2.0 Programme".
Write the name of the post you are applying for and the name of the department at the top of the form.

Complete the form sections: Personal Information, Educational Qualifications, Research Work/Publication, Workshops/Seminars/Conferences/Symposia Attended, Professional Experience, Thesis Details, References and Other information (Awards/recognitions).
Affix a colour passport size photo in the box on the form.
Sign the declaration with your full name, place and date.
Attach the required documents with the application.
Address the application to: PI, Project XI, RUSA 2.0, Department of Community and Applied Science, University of Rajasthan, Jaipur.
Make sure the application reaches the Department of Community and Applied Science before 4:00 PM on 27 November 2026.
The notice does not specify whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand. It also does not list the required documents item by item.

rows.details: Department of Community and Applied Science (Earlier known as Home Science)
Project XI, RUSA 2.0: "Sustainable strategies for improving the Nutritional and Health status of Vulnerable groups in Tonk District"
Research Associate: Rs. 47000/- + HRA; Project Assistant: Rs. 25000/-
Department of Community and Applied Science, University of Rajasthan, Jaipur, with field work in the project's study area (Tonk District)

content_sections.heading: About University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The posts are in the Department of Community and Applied Science, earlier known as Home Science, at the University of Rajasthan, Jaipur-302004. The work is for Project XI under RUSA 2.0, a study titled "Sustainable strategies for improving the Nutritional and Health status of Vulnerable groups in Tonk District". The notice refers to Office Order No. F.35-532/PP/P-11/2026/2706 dated 24.10.2026, and it is signed by Prof. Reshma Boolchandani (PI) and Prof. Shubha Dube (Co PI).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 4 posts in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the Research Associate post, a candidate whose Ph.D. thesis has been submitted can apply, as can one whose Ph.D. has been awarded. The notice does not mention any desirable qualification, experience requirement or age limit for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc in Foods & Human Nutrition /Human Development & Family & Development Communication & Extension

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Research Associate: Rs. 47000/- plus HRA. Project Assistant: Rs. 25000/-. The notice mentions no HRA for this post. The appointment will be temporary and will be till 31.03.2027. Both posts are part of RUSA 2.0 Project XI.

content_sections.heading: University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Will undertake the necessary work required for completion of the project. Will carry out the necessary field work in study area. Will do the interpretation & compilation of the analyzed data. Will do the report writing. Will be required to carry out the field visits in the study area for reinforcing the key messages imparted. Will develop messages for IEC material and spread awareness in the field regarding the same. Will demonstrate nutrient rich recipes in the field for combating anemia among the vulnerable groups. Will impart information regarding correct nutrition practices in the community in collaboration with AWW & helpers. Will do the data tabulation. Will help in report writing of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made on paper. The application form is printed with the notice under the University of Rajasthan letterhead, headed "Name of the Post for which apply under RUSA 2.0 Programme". Write the name of the post you are applying for and the name of the department at the top of the form. Complete the form sections: Personal Information, Educational Qualifications, Research Work/Publication, Workshops/Seminars/Conferences/Symposia Attended, Professional Experience, Thesis Details, References and Other information (Awards/recognitions). Affix a colour passport size photo in the box on the form. Sign the declaration with your full name, place and date. Attach the required documents with the application. Address the application to: PI, Project XI, RUSA 2.0, Department of Community and Applied Science, University of Rajasthan, Jaipur. Make sure the application reaches the Department of Community and Applied Science before 4:00 PM on 27 November 2026. The notice does not specify whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand. It also does not list the required documents item by item.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened, and candidates shortlisted for an interview will be informed via email. Applicants should therefore write a working e-mail ID in the form. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for interview or travel. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts in total: 2 Research Associates and 2 Project Assistants under RUSA 2.0 Project XI.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Department of Community and Applied Science, University of Rajasthan, before 4:00 PM on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Research Associate needs a Ph.D. in Foods & Human Nutrition, and a submitted or an awarded Ph.D. is accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Project Assistant needs an M.Sc in Foods & Human Nutrition /Human Development & Family & Development Communication & Extension.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The Research Associate gets Rs. 47000/- + HRA, and the Project Assistant gets Rs. 25000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Research Associate post HRA is paid in addition to Rs. 47000/-. The notice mentions no HRA for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form printed with the notice, attach the required documents, and address it to PI, Project XI, RUSA 2.0, Department of Community and Applied Science, University of Rajasthan, Jaipur. It must reach the department before 4:00 PM on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted for an interview, and shortlisted candidates will be informed via email.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment will be temporary and will be till 31 March 2027, under RUSA 2.0 Project XI.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for interview or travel.
